name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
services: 24/7 phone, chat and text with advocates; safety planning; referrals
notes: Cited by Alameda, SF, Santa Clara county pages.
channel_notes: Chat at thehotline.org; text START to 88788.
when_to_use: You want anonymous support or are not sure where to start. Works while a partner is nearby if you use chat or text.

name: CalVCB (California Victim Compensation Board)
services: Pays crime-related costs not covered elsewhere: relocation, mental health, medical, dental, home security.
access_note: Apply online (EN/ES) or by paper; an advocate can help via victims.ca.gov/get-help. Relay: 711.
notes: No police report required: DV program letter, medical/mental-health records or a restraining order can be used. Fact sheet does not name transportation or emergency housing explicitly; confirm with CalVCB.
channel_notes: Apply online (English/Spanish); no police report needed.
when_to_use: You want help paying for relocation, counseling or medical costs. Application can be started while partner is home, but keep any paperwork where it can't be found.

name: California Safe at Home (Secretary of State)
services: Substitute mailing address accepted by state/county/city agencies; confidential voter registration.
access_note: Enroll by appointment with a designated Enrolling Agency (look-up on the SOS site). Email SafeAtHome@sos.ca.gov. Also (916) 653-6814.
notes: Duration/renewal terms not stated on the page; confirm with program.
channel_notes: Requires an appointment with an enrolling agency.
when_to_use: You want your new address kept confidential.

name: NNEDV Safety Net (technology safety)

when_to_use: You think your phone or accounts are being monitored.
